agent.notes: The changed lines are in Polar server service methods (SubscriptionService.cycle, OrderService.create_subscription_order, the order payment and retry paths, and the order.create_subscription_order task). These need a PostgreSQL database because the models use Postgres-only types, plus the Dramatiq/Redis job queue (enqueue_job) and the Stripe API. The PR adds a required argument to create_subscription_order, so the same direct call can't run on both versions, and _generate_statement_descriptor exists only in head. The rest is a migration (SQL) and a new non-null model column. Neither venv installed (setuptools package discovery error). The new logic is trivial string prefixing and slicing, which would be dominated by database and Stripe I/O.
